_about: Data for the combined station js/cook/stations/roll-tawa.js (lab-only proof). `station` is its name and goal line (merged into data.stations); `mechanic.levels` are its difficulty levels: here, which level each zone's mechanic runs at (tawa level 2 = two tawas). `band` (SH-248): the bottom row's band, the stone tray, as maani's: the spare dough and the plate lie on it (Sprint 20 batch 2: the room in the kitchen frame, js/cook/stations/roll-tawa.js). `onboard` (RT-02): the first-time script the kit's coach plays (data.onboard['roll-tawa'], put there by the station's code when the data names none).

station.name: Roll and cook
station.goal: Roll each maani on the board. It goes to the tawa: flip it on the green while you roll the next.

onboard.what: roll the ball up and down until the maani fills the ring (RT-02, Fable 15 Nov: the kit's first-time light, dim and one gold box, as chai's; maani-line's roll step)
the next dough ball on the tray
